title: MTP per-layer loss overwritten instead of accumulated when log_interval > 1
root_cause: MTPLossLoggingHelper.save_loss_to_tracker assigned total_loss_dict[name] = loss for each iteration regardless of whether the key already existed. Across multiple training iterations within one logging window, only the most recent iteration's MTP loss survived; the logged value was the last-step loss rather than the average over log_interval steps.
invariant: Within a single log_interval window, total_loss_dict[mtp_name] must equal the running sum of mtp_losses[i] across iterations until the window flushes.
diff_summary: Replaced 'total_loss_dict[name] = loss' with 'if name in total_loss_dict: total_loss_dict[name] += loss; else: total_loss_dict[name] = loss'.
